build_single_stage_detector: build a SingleStageDetector with backbone, neck, and bbox_head config for object detection
run_loss_calculation: run the loss method to calculate detection losses from a batch of input images and data samples
run_object_prediction: run the predict method to get bounding box predictions with scores and labels from input images
run_feature_extraction: run extract_feat to get multi-level feature tensors from the backbone and neck of the detector
review_state_dict_loading: review the _load_from_state_dict method that maps rpn_head keys to bbox_head keys when loading weights
